newsitem.title: FINLAND: SANTASALO TO OPEN AUSTRALIA SERVICE CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: SANTASALO TO OPEN AUSTRALIA SERVICE CENTRE.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Santasalo-JOT Oy said in a statement on Friday its industrial gear business would open a service centre in Australia together with privately-owned German company SEW Eurodrive.
Later this year, Santasalo and SEW would open a similar industrial gear service centre in Thailand, and China was next in turn, it said.
"By expanding service operations the company is supporting new international sales of industrial gears," it said.
SEW Eurodrive is already marketing Santasalo gears through its worldwide sales network, Santasalo said.

With assembly plants in 37 countries, SEW Eurodrive is the world's biggest maker of industrial gears. The German company is focusing on gears for smaller engines while Santasalo is targetting big industrial gears, it said.
The companies' close cooperation in marketing offered good opportunities for cooperation in services, maintenance and spare parts, it added.
